text: In the three days since the last run (7 November), beauty again gained by far the most new reviews (about 37,200), led by a ₹138 Wildplay perfume (+5,705), while the single fastest non-beauty mover was a ₹91 fridge cover (+1,649) and kids' winter sets and a ₹128 Dabur toothpaste combo also moved fast. For a beginner, home & kitchen and jewellery still look best, with kids' basics and bags close behind: cheap, light, no sizes (except kids) and around 7% 1-star reviews.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurtis lead, lace and Banarasi sarees arrive after Diwali
text: Kurtis still have the most reviews, and in the three days since the last run a ₹352 shimmer saree with mirror work (+345), a ₹244 kurti (+311) and a ₹223 kurti (+252) gained the most, with the category adding about 3,800 new reviews. Eight listings are new to the page, mostly georgette lace sarees and Banarasi silk sarees, which fits the wedding season running through November and December. The typical price is about ₹292, with about 9.3% 1-star reviews, likely because of size and colour complaints. Sellers are mainly in Gujarat (23 of 39) and Rajasthan, close to the textile hubs, so a beginner would be competing with factory-direct sellers on sizes and returns.

headline: Women's western: tank tops and shirts lead, hoodies and jackets rise with winter
text: A ₹165 tank top gained the most reviews since the last run (+362), followed by a ₹194 women's shirt (+347) and a ₹294 girls' jacket (+309), and the category added about 4,000 new reviews. New to the page are a crop hoodie, a collar sweatshirt and oversized T-shirts, so winter layers are clearly picking up. The typical price is about ₹262 with about 7.6% 1-star reviews, lower than most clothing. Most sellers are in Delhi (20 of 38); sizes still mean returns, so this is workable but not the easiest start.

headline: Men's clothing: slowest category again, shirts lead and sweatshirts arrive
text: Men's clothing gained the fewest new reviews again, only about 540 in three days, mostly on shirts priced ₹248 to ₹352, led by a ₹260 shirt (+126). Fleece sweatshirts, hoodies and a winter sweater are rising on the page, but they have only a few hundred to about 1,300 reviews so far. About 12.1% of reviews are 1-star, among the highest of any category, likely because of fit and fabric complaints. Sellers are spread across Punjab, Rajasthan and Delhi; slow sales plus sizes plus complaints make this a poor first pick.

headline: Kids & toys: cheap clothing sets and winter thermals keep moving
text: Kids gained about 6,300 new reviews in three days, led by a ₹182 three-pack cat print set (+691), a ₹171 kids' wool thermal set (+533), a ₹189 boys' set (+523) and a ₹203 kids' sweater set (+518). New and rising are a wooden coin box, baby booties, a ₹221 pull-back police car and a ₹318 dancing cactus toy. The typical price is low at about ₹184, with about 8.8% 1-star reviews. Clothing needs sizes, so for a beginner simple toys and learning boards are the easier route, and Children's Day (14 November) and Christmas can lift toys.

headline: Home & kitchen: fridge covers are the fastest movers again
text: A ₹91 fridge cover gained the most reviews since the last run (+1,649), followed by ₹73 incense sticks (+627), a ₹167 crystal LED lamp (+430) and a ₹367 collapsible shoe rack (+350), and the category added about 3,750 new reviews. New to the page are kitchen tools such as a steel flask set, an egg storage box, steel tongs, a cup stand and a tea strainer. The typical price is the lowest of any category at about ₹150, with about 7.3% 1-star reviews. Sellers are mostly in Delhi and Gujarat; light, no sizes and few complaints make this the best place for a beginner to start.

headline: Beauty: cheap perfumes lead again, but big brands dominate
text: Beauty gained about 37,200 new reviews in three days, far more than any other category. A ₹138 Wildplay perfume (+5,705), a Ghar Soaps face wash (+3,982), a ₹149 French Essence body spray (+3,523) and a ₹226 Mamaearth face wash (+3,436) moved most, and body lotions are new to the page as winter dries skin. Most top products are brands such as Ghar Soaps, Muuchstac, Mamaearth, Pond's and Vaseline, which need brand approval to sell. Only 28 products were read here; the typical price is about ₹205 with about 8.4% 1-star reviews, so demand is huge but hard to reach without your own brand.

headline: Jewellery: light, cheap and in the middle of wedding season
text: A ₹151 golden bracelet gained the most reviews since the last run (+295), followed by a ₹103 five-necklace combo (+230) and a ₹163 silver plated American diamond set (+198), and the category added about 1,740 new reviews. Eight listings are new, mostly jewellery sets, a raani haar and mangalsutras, and a ₹243 chunky mangalsutra is rising fast, which fits the wedding season through December. The typical price is about ₹190 with about 7.4% 1-star reviews. Sellers are mainly in Maharashtra and Gujarat; light, no sizes and low complaints make jewellery one of the best beginner picks.

headline: Bags & footwear: sling bags and totes lead, shoes need sizes
text: Handbags have the most reviews, and a ₹151 sling bag (+236), a ₹186 shoulder bag (+201), a ₹166 printed tote (+188) and a ₹251 handbag (+180) gained the most in three days, with the category adding about 2,840 new reviews. New to the page are slip-on sports shoes and slipper packs. The typical price is about ₹206 with about 7.3% 1-star reviews. Most sellers are in Delhi (24 of 40); bags are a good beginner choice because they have no sizes, while shoes bring size returns.

headline: Electronics accessories: speakers lead, highest complaint rate
text: Bluetooth speakers have the most reviews, and a ₹382 wooden speaker (+493), an ₹84 phone stand two-pack (+292) and a ₹282 speaker (+208) gained the most in three days. New and rising are a ₹186 selfie stick tripod, neckband earphones and 'AirPods Pro' style earbuds, which carry brand-copy risk. The typical price is the highest of any category at about ₹329, and 12.5% of reviews are 1-star, the highest complaint rate. Sellers are mainly in Delhi and Haryana; only simple items like phone stands suit a beginner.

headline: Health & fitness: brands lead pads, ear patches and sports gear are the easy picks
text: Health gained about 9,000 new reviews in three days, second only to beauty, led by a ₹128 Dabur Red toothpaste combo (+2,549), Everteen and Stayfree pads (+1,026 and +891) and ₹68 earlobe support patches (+838). New and rising are ear cleaning kits, footballs and badminton rackets. The typical price is about ₹237, and at about 5.5% 1-star reviews this is the lowest complaint rate of any category. Pads, toothpaste and ointments are branded or regulated, so a beginner should look at earlobe patches, ear cleaners and simple sports items instead.

headline: Wall shelves: steady seller, small numbers, first look at the list
text: This is the first run for wall shelves, so there is no previous run to compare with yet. Only 20 products were read, and the top one, a ₹313 plain wooden shelf, has about 5,800 reviews, far less than top products in jewellery or home & kitchen, so demand is real but modest. The typical price is about ₹284 with about 8.3% 1-star reviews, and cheaper decorative shelves around ₹110 to ₹150 are also on the page. Sellers are mainly in Uttar Pradesh (11 of 20) and Rajasthan, likely near wood-craft hubs; shelves need no sizes but are bulky and can break in transit, which raises shipping cost and returns for a beginner.

Fridge covers around ₹90 to ₹100 (home & kitchen, fastest mover again)
American diamond jewellery sets and necklace combos around ₹100 to ₹170 (wedding season)
Sling bags and printed tote bags around ₹150 to ₹190
Small kitchen tools such as cup stands, tea strainers and egg boxes around ₹100 to ₹150
Invisible earlobe support patches around ₹70
Simple kids' toys such as pull-back cars around ₹200 (Children's Day and Christmas)

Avoid for now: men's shirts (slowest growth and 12.1% 1-star reviews), earbuds and speakers (highest complaint rate and copy-brand risk), branded beauty and sanitary products that need brand approval, and size-heavy clothing like sarees and kurtis with 9%+ 1-star reviews.
